briefing: Field Report from Agent Polaris: Multiple sources are reporting on large-scale fraud in Minnesota, including a $19 billion welfare and daycare fraud scandal. The Quality Learning Center in Minnesota has been shut down, and there are reports of widespread fraud in California's childcare programs. These investigations are active and ongoing, with multiple agencies involved. The Minnesota DHS and California State Authorities are leading the investigations. There are concerns about the extent of the fraud and who was involved. Further investigation is needed to uncover the full scope of the schemes.
